name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A date field with a calendar popover on Base UI and calendar-core. Typed dates parse in the field's locale, months slide the way you page, the selection glides between days, and ranges preview as you hover.
docs: Import DatePicker (or Calendar for an inline grid) from components/eased/date-picker/date-picker; wrap it in Field for a label and messages. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
